svg.text: A forecasting pipeline that collects daily market data, builds
features from price and volume history, and combines LSTM and
Bayesian network models to estimate short term price movement.
Predictions are served through an API and compared against real
Scheduled ingestion and cleaning of historical OHLCV data into SQL
Features such as moving averages, RSI, volatility and volume trends
LSTM networks that learn temporal patterns from sequences of past
Bayesian networks that model how indicators depend on each other and
Walk-forward validation, backtesting and a dashboard that tracks
